_meta.scope: Invariant across all Swayam creatives. Import into every render; never override per creative.

brand.name: Swayam
brand.promise: Revenue runs itself—until you need a human.

strategy.purpose: Give growth-minded businesses an autonomous revenue engine — marketing spend, conversations, and pipeline work together toward conversion.
strategy.positioning: For revenue leaders tired of CRMs that only store leads — Swayam is the agentic CRM that runs ads, captures leads, automates WhatsApp, and manages pipeline in one stack.

values.name: Revenue-first
values.definition: Measure success in conversions and revenue, not vanity metrics

values.name: Agentic by default
values.definition: Automation and AI do the work; humans set strategy

values.name: End-to-end ownership
values.definition: One stack from ad to close — no broken handoffs

values.name: Transparent operations
values.definition: Clients see what agents did and why

values.name: Practical intelligence
values.definition: AI that counsellors and owners can act on today

logo.icon_concept: stylized S-loop — ad → lead → convert cycle
logo.clear_space: minimum height of S icon on all sides

overlay.workflow: Generate creative WITHOUT logo in AI prompt. Run apply_logo.py after generation.

variants.light: White wordmark + teal descriptor — for dark/navy backgrounds
variants.dark: Navy wordmark + teal descriptor — for light/neutral backgrounds

overlay.auto_select: From visual_identity.background hex, logo element color, or sampled region luminance

dont: place on busy photography without scrim
use Sensible CRM in customer-facing materials

ui_patterns.ai_indicator: indigo left border or soft ai_muted background; sparkle icon sparingly
ui_patterns.charts: primary navy series; amber for revenue/conversion series

voice.tone: confident operator — sharp, evidence-led, revenue language
voice.headline_tone: bold outcome-focused — revenue loop, not contact storage

prefer: real dashboard screenshots over abstract stock
avoid: competitor LLM logos as hero icons
invented metrics or fake revenue numbers on mockups
imagery.agent_presence: subtle motion, status indicators, agent-completed patterns — not sci-fi

constraints.accessibility: Body text on neutral_50 uses text color (AAA). Primary buttons: white on primary or secondary (AA+).
compliance: WhatsApp marketing templates include opt-out language where required
Ad claims tied to reportable in-product metrics
No fully autonomous claims where human review is legally required
naming: Lead with Swayam in product contexts
Lead with agentic integration in agency/sales contexts
EduHexa is a vertical proof point, not the master brand
